description: Get a compound's interaction data: drug-food interactions, and the molecular targets its bioassays name — one entry per target as kinds defines it, with its assay counts by outcome and most potent active value, Active targets first, most potent first. Each entry carries its originating source. Results are paged per kind, with the record total and the next offset reported for each. Drug-food coverage is richest for approved drugs; target covers any compound PubChem has assay data for, and pubchem_get_bioactivity lists one target's assays when given the entry's GeneID or accession. Drug-drug interactions (DrugBank) are unavailable while PubChem's SDQ service refuses automated requests: an explicit drug-drug request is reported in failedKinds while the other kinds still return.

cid.description: PubChem Compound ID. Resolve from name/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

kinds.description: Interaction kinds to fetch. "drug-food" (dietary interactions, from PUG View), "target" (molecular targets from the compound's assay summary: one entry per Gene ID with the accessions the table pairs with it, and one per identifier it never pairs, so a Gene ID and an accession that no row pairs are separate entries even when they name the same protein), "drug-drug" (interactions with other drugs, from PubChem's SDQ service, which refuses automated requests, so it is reported in failedKinds). Default: ["drug-food"].

maxEntries.description: Max entries per kind per page. The per-call cap is 50: a larger value (up to 1000) reads a page of 50 per kind and is reported in cappedInputs. Well-studied drugs have a long tail of interactions; use offset to reach the ones past this page. Default: 10.

offset.description: Zero-based start position within each requested kind, counted in records (molecular targets, for target) rather than returned entries. The same offset applies to every kind in the call, and the kinds advance at different rates — when paging past the first page, request one kind per call and pass that kind's nextOffset. Default: 0.

name: pubchem_get_compound_interactions

cappedInputs.description: Inputs that asked for more than their per-call cap, with the value requested and the value served. An ID batch lists the IDs past the cap in unprocessed. Omitted when every input was within its cap.

items.description: One input served at its per-call cap.

requested.description: Value requested: the page size, or the number of IDs in the batch.

unprocessed.description: ID batches only: IDs past the cap, listed in unprocessed in input order.

entries.description: Interaction entries across the requested kinds.

partner.description: Interacting compound as the source reports it. For a target: its gene or protein name and organism, then the identifier pubchem_get_bioactivity filters on (GeneID:N → targetGeneId, accession:X → targetAccession); the identifier alone when no name resolves. A target whose identifiers join several Gene IDs is named by the accession they share and says "group of N Gene IDs".

text.description: The interaction statement. For a target: the assays naming it by outcome and its most potent Active value with that AID, in µM.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

failedKinds.description: Interaction kinds that could not be retrieved (comma-separated). The returned entries cover the kinds that succeeded. The notice says, per failed kind, whether a retry can help: a timeout or upstream error can clear, while a refusal from PubChem's SDQ service (drug-drug) does not.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass on the next call, reported when exactly one requested kind has records remaining. Omitted when none do, and when several do — those advance to different positions, so read paging[].nextOffset instead.

notice.description: Guidance when a kind failed, when no interaction data was found, when the offset runs past every requested kind, when target names could not be retrieved, or when further pages remain. Absent when this page is complete and every kind resolved.

offset.description: Zero-based start position read within each requested kind.

paging.description: Per-kind page position, one entry per requested kind that was retrieved. A kind listed in failedKinds is absent — its position is unknown, not exhausted.

items.description: Page position for one interaction kind.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass on the next call to continue this kind past the current page. Omitted when no records remain.

returnedCount.description: Interaction entries returned for this kind.

totalRecords.description: Records available for this kind, across all pages: interaction records for drug-drug and drug-food, molecular targets for target. Entries are derived from these records and can be fewer: a drug-drug record carrying no statement yields nothing. Pages divide the records, not the entries.

truncated.description: True when source records remain for this kind past the current page.

returnedCount.description: Total interaction entries returned across all kinds.

truncated.description: True when at least one requested kind has source records remaining past this page. Which kinds, and how many records each holds, is in paging[].truncated / paging[].totalRecords.

title: Get Compound Interactions
